ambiguity_notes: The spec says 'Reset release is synchronous to clk' but the reset itself is asynchronous; I interpreted this as: the reset de-assertion (rst_n going high) is sampled on the next rising edge of clk before normal operation resumes, while assertion is still asynchronous.
The spec does not explicitly state what dout outputs when shift_out_en is low or done is low; I assumed dout is 0 in those cases.

The spec says done 'clears on reset or new load' but does not specify the exact cycle on which done clears when load_en is asserted during unload; I assumed done clears on the first rising edge where load_en is high.

The spec does not define behaviour if shift_out_en is de-asserted mid-unload and then re-asserted; I assumed the unload counter pauses (does not advance) while shift_out_en is low, allowing partial unload and resume.

The spec does not explicitly state whether the key schedule update for round i happens before or after round i's addRoundKey; I assumed the key used for round i's addRoundKey is the key_reg value before the round-i key schedule update, and the schedule update produces the key for round i+1, consistent with the PRESENT specification.

The spec states the final addRoundKey uses 'key_reg[79:16] after the 31st key update'; I interpreted this as the key schedule is applied 31 times (once after each of rounds 1..31), and the resulting key_reg is used for the 32nd addRoundKey.
The spec does not specify the initial value of dout or state/key_reg after reset; I assumed all internal registers including state and key_reg are cleared to 0 on reset.

The spec does not clarify whether load_en going low before 144 bits are shifted in causes the partial load to be retained or discarded; I assumed the load counter and shift register retain their state if load_en goes low mid-load, and loading resumes if load_en goes high again (unless reset occurs).

The spec says 'Auto-starts on cycle the 144th bit is shifted in'; I interpreted this as the encrypt phase begins on the same rising edge that captures the 144th bit, meaning the first round computation uses the fully loaded key_reg and state.

behavior_invariants.condition: Whenever rst_n is low (asynchronous), done must be 0 on the very same clock edge or combinatorially, and the FSM returns to idle regardless of load_en, shift_out_en, or encryption state
behavior_invariants.description: Asserting rst_n low immediately clears done and aborts any in-progress operation
behavior_invariants.name: reset_clears_done

behavior_invariants.condition: On each rising edge of clk where load_en is high, din is shifted into the concatenated shift register {key_reg[79:0], state[63:0]} MSB-first; the first 80 bits received become key_reg (key[79] arrives first), the next 64 bits become state (plaintext[63] arrives first); after the 144th such bit the load phase ends
behavior_invariants.description: Exactly 144 rising edges of clk with load_en high are required to fully load key and plaintext
behavior_invariants.name: load_phase_144_cycles

behavior_invariants.condition: No external trigger is needed; the FSM transitions from LOAD to ENCRYPT on the same rising edge that captures the 144th serial bit, and the first round computation begins immediately
behavior_invariants.description: Encryption begins automatically on the clock cycle that the 144th load bit is captured
behavior_invariants.name: encrypt_auto_starts

behavior_invariants.condition: Rounds 1 through 31 each execute one addRoundKey, sBoxLayer, and pLayer per clock cycle, followed by a 32nd cycle that applies only the final addRoundKey using the key_reg value after the 31st key schedule update; done is asserted at the end of the 32nd encrypt cycle
behavior_invariants.description: Encryption completes in exactly 32 clock cycles: 31 full rounds plus one final addRoundKey
behavior_invariants.name: encrypt_takes_32_cycles

behavior_invariants.condition: At the start of each round (including the final addRoundKey), state is updated to state XOR key_reg[79:16]; the lower 16 bits of key_reg are not used in the XOR
behavior_invariants.description: addRoundKey XORs the upper 64 bits of key_reg into state
behavior_invariants.name: addroundkey_operation

behavior_invariants.condition: State is divided into 16 nibbles (nibble 0 = state[3:0], nibble 15 = state[63:60]); each nibble n is replaced by S[n] where S = {0xC,0x5,0x6,0xB,0x9,0x0,0xA,0xD,0x3,0xE,0xF,0x8,0x4,0x7,0x1,0x2} (index 0 maps to 0xC, index 15 maps to 0x2)
behavior_invariants.description: sBoxLayer applies the PRESENT S-box independently to each of the 16 four-bit nibbles of state
behavior_invariants.name: sbox_layer_operation

behavior_invariants.condition: Bit i of the pre-permutation state is moved to position P(i) in the post-permutation state, where P(i) = (i multiplied by 16) modulo 63 for i in 0 through 62, and P(63) = 63
behavior_invariants.description: pLayer applies the PRESENT bit permutation to state
behavior_invariants.name: player_operation

behavior_invariants.condition: After the current round's key is consumed, key_reg is updated by rotating it left by 61 bits, meaning the new key_reg equals the concatenation of the old key_reg[60:0] as the upper bits and old key_reg[79:61] as the lower bits
behavior_invariants.description: Key schedule rotates key_reg left by 61 bit positions after each round
behavior_invariants.name: key_schedule_rotation

behavior_invariants.condition: After the 61-bit left rotation, the four most-significant bits of key_reg (bits 79 through 76) are replaced by S applied to those four bits using the same PRESENT S-box
behavior_invariants.description: Key schedule applies the S-box to the top nibble of key_reg after rotation
behavior_invariants.name: key_schedule_sbox

behavior_invariants.condition: After the S-box substitution on the top nibble, the 5-bit round index i (ranging from 1 to 31) is XORed into bits 19 through 15 of key_reg; bits outside this range are unaffected
behavior_invariants.description: Key schedule XORs the 5-bit round counter into key_reg bits 19:15
behavior_invariants.name: key_schedule_round_counter_xor

behavior_invariants.condition: Once done is asserted it stays high across subsequent clock cycles; it is cleared only when rst_n goes low (asynchronously) or when load_en goes high to begin a new load sequence
behavior_invariants.description: done remains asserted after encryption completes until reset or a new load begins
behavior_invariants.name: done_held_until_cleared

behavior_invariants.condition: On each rising edge of clk where both done and shift_out_en are high, the next most-significant remaining bit of state is presented on dout; state[63] is output first and state[0] is output last; exactly 64 such cycles are needed to unload the full ciphertext
behavior_invariants.description: Ciphertext is shifted out MSB-first on dout while done is high and shift_out_en is high
behavior_invariants.name: unload_serial_output

behavior_invariants.condition: When shift_out_en is low or done is low, dout outputs 0
behavior_invariants.description: dout is 0 when not in the unload phase
behavior_invariants.name: dout_idle_value

behavior_invariants.condition: For key=0x00000000000000000000 and plaintext=0x0000000000000000 the ciphertext must be 0x5579C1387B228445; for key=0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF and plaintext=0x0000000000000000 the ciphertext must be 0xE72C46C0F5945049; for key=0x00000000000000000000 and plaintext=0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF the ciphertext must be 0xA112FFC72F68417B; for key=0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF and plaintext=0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF the ciphertext must be 0x3333DCD3213210D2
behavior_invariants.description: The module must produce the specified ciphertext for each of the four published test vectors
behavior_invariants.name: test_vector_correctness

behavior_invariants.condition: If load_en goes high at any point after the load phase has ended (during encryption or unload), the FSM returns to the load state, done is cleared, and a fresh 144-cycle load sequence begins
behavior_invariants.description: Asserting load_en while encryption is in progress or after done is asserted starts a new load and clears done
behavior_invariants.name: load_en_aborts_encryption

behavior_invariants.condition: done must remain 0 throughout the load phase and throughout all 32 encryption cycles; it is asserted only after the final addRoundKey of the 32nd encrypt cycle has been registered
behavior_invariants.description: done is never asserted before all 32 encrypt cycles have completed
behavior_invariants.name: no_partial_encrypt_output

clock_domains.name: clk
clock_domains.notes: Single clock domain; all registers are rising-edge triggered on clk

port_assumptions.notes: Rising-edge triggered; 100 MHz target, 10 ns period
Asynchronous active-low reset; release is synchronous to clk
Must be held high for exactly 144 consecutive rising edges to complete a load; asserting it mid-encryption restarts the load
Serial input; sampled on rising edge of clk when load_en is high; key MSB (bit 79) arrives first, plaintext MSB (bit 63) arrives after the 80th key bit
Only effective when done is also high; can be de-asserted and re-asserted to pause unloading
MSB of ciphertext (state[63]) is output first; 0 when not unloading
Registered output; asserted after 32nd encrypt cycle completes; cleared by rst_n or load_en
